title: ONV CAT6 RJ45 Connector
minimum: This product has a minimum quantity of 100

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The ONV CAT6 RJ45 Connectors are high-quality 8P8C Ethernet plugs designed for reliable and stable network cable termination. These connectors are ideal for creating custom CAT6 LAN cables used in networking environments such as offices, data centers, CCTV installations, and home networks.


Manufactured with precision, ONV RJ45 connectors ensure secure pin alignment, minimal signal loss, and stable data transmission. They support Gigabit Ethernet speeds (up to 1Gbps) and are compatible with CAT6 UTP cables, providing improved performance over standard CAT5e connectors.


These connectors are easy to install using standard crimping tools and are suitable for both professional technicians and DIY network setups. Built with durable plastic housing and gold-plated contacts, they offer long-lasting performance and resistance to corrosion.


Key Features


  • High-quality CAT6 RJ45 (8P8C) connectors
  • Supports Gigabit Ethernet (10/100/1000 Mbps)
  • Compatible with CAT6 UTP cables
  • Gold-plated contacts for better conductivity
  • Durable and reliable construction
  • Easy installation with standard crimping tools
  • Ideal for LAN cable making and repairs
  • Suitable for networking, CCTV, and ISP use
